### 1 — Scene
A cooked breakfast-style meal: scrambled eggs mixed with potato pieces, tomato and possibly bacon, with two browned sausage pieces. Some ingredients are difficult to distinguish in the strong sunlight.

### 2 — Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be scrambled eggs, cooked potatoes, chopped tomato, small bacon pieces and sausages. Cooking fat is included in the energy estimates; no separate pool of oil or sauce is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares partition the visible food footprint to avoid counting overlapping ingredients twice.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Scrambled eggs | 23% | 122 cm² × 1.5 cm = 183 ml | 0.95 | 174 g | 160 | 278 kcal |
| Cooked potato pieces | 12% | 64 cm² × 2 cm = 128 ml | 0.70 | 90 g | 140 | 126 kcal |
| Chopped tomato | 6% | 32 cm² × 1.2 cm = 38 ml | 0.60 | 23 g | 20 | 5 kcal |
| Bacon pieces | 4% | 21 cm² × 0.8 cm = 17 ml | 0.90 | 15 g | 450 | 68 kcal |
| Browned sausage pieces | 13% | 69 cm² × 1.6 cm = 110 ml | 0.95 | 105 g | 300 | 315 kcal |

**Food coverage: 58%** of the plate; the remaining 42% is exposed plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate totals **407 g and approximately 790 kcal**, plausible for the visible mound of eggs and potatoes plus two sausage pieces. Ingredient identification and hidden cooking fat are the largest uncertainties.
